A1.justification: Both readable 11-page PDFs describe the same FAST work, with matching scientific text, equations, tables and figures. All supplied pages support direct comparison. Both end with references; neither contains the Appendix mentioned in the text, so no appendix material is available to assess.

before.justification: v1 reports original classification, computational-efficiency, cross-architecture and ablation results in Section 4, Tables 1–2 and Figures 5–11.

after.justification: v2 retains the original experimental results in Section 4, Tables 1–2 and Figures 5–11.

M1.justification: Sections 3.1–3.5 retain the same graph construction, spectral embedding, assignment and regularization constraints, phase-decoupled CFD, progressive frequency sampling and joint objective.

E1.justification: Both retain CIFAR-10/100, SVHN, TinyImageNet, DTD and RESISC45 evaluations, Alpaca instruction tuning evaluated with InstructEval, and the reported CUB-200-2011 experiment. No dataset, task or test scenario changes.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in Tables 1–2 and the plotted comparisons, including NMS, the DNN-based coreset baselines, MSE/CE/KL metric alternatives and NCFM in the frequency-count comparison.

E3.justification: The stated architectures, 10%/20%/30% keep rates, 200-epoch training setup, preprocessing and batch sizes are unchanged. Both retain the same early-stopping efficiency evaluation and frequency-selection and phase-constraint ablation settings.

E4.justification: Both contain the same cross-architecture analysis and ablations of distribution metrics, graph constraints, frequency-selection strategies, frequency counts and phase penalties. Figures 5–11 and their supporting analyses add or remove no tested question.

E5.justification: Neither supplied PDF reports repeated-run counts, random seeds, confidence intervals, standard deviations or significance tests. No uncertainty-reporting practice changes.

E6.justification: Tables 1–2 and all plotted results retain their values and trends. For example, FAST's CIFAR-10 accuracy at 10% retention remains 90.32%, and FAST-CPU remains 353.0 seconds and 1.409 Wh in Table 2. The reported LLM and CUB gains are also unchanged.

T1.justification: Equations (1)–(16), the characteristic-function moment/cumulant reasoning and the vanishing-phase-gradient argument are unchanged. The referenced appendix derivations and proofs are absent from both supplied PDFs.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same novelty, distribution-matching, generalization and efficiency claims, including the stated 9.12% accuracy gain, 96.57% power reduction and 2.2× speedup.

C2.justification: Both retain the same explanations connecting distributional alignment to generalization, graph constraints to avoiding collapse, and progressive sampling to stable convergence. The discussion of excessive phase penalties amplifying noise is unchanged; no substantive limitation or qualification is added.

D1.justification: Implementation and reproducibility disclosures are identical, including optimizer settings, batch sizes, Xeon/A100 and RK3588 hardware, and Zeus/RAPL energy measurement. No code or data access information changes.

R1.justification: The same 48 references and related-work discussion are retained, including the positioning against NMS and NCFM. Changed citation back-reference page numbers follow text reflow rather than changes in cited work.

P1.justification: v2 places Boran Zhao before Jin Cui, reorders affiliation numbering and shortens the affiliation block by removing the National Engineering Research Center line. Scientific prose, terminology and section order remain unchanged.

P2.justification: The shorter affiliation block changes column and page breaks, including moving Equation (4) from page 5 to page 4, with small placement shifts elsewhere. All eleven figures and both tables retain their content, structure and captions.

improvement.justification: The revision changes author presentation, affiliations and text flow without changing the method, evidence, explanations or reproducibility information. It establishes no meaningful quality gain or loss. The referenced appendices remain absent, and the Figure 11 discrepancy between the text's 0.3 optimum and the caption's 0.4 optimum remains unresolved.
